title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 8: A2 EVERYDAY COMMUNICATION
description: An ambitious elementary-English world that develops longer conversations, practical grammar, richer vocabulary, everyday problem solving, reading for meaning, natural listening and independent production.

missions.title: A2 Vocabulary Power-Up
missions.focus: high-frequency A2 verbs, adjectives, collocations and everyday phrases

missions.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
missions.focus: routines versus actions happening now, temporary situations and time expressions

missions.title: Past Stories — What Happened?
missions.focus: past simple, sequence markers, regular and irregular verbs, telling connected events

missions.title: Past Continuous Adventure
missions.focus: was/were + -ing, background actions, interrupted events and when/while

missions.title: Future Choices
missions.focus: going to, will for simple decisions/predictions, plans and promises

missions.title: Life Experiences
missions.focus: ever/never, already/yet, simple present perfect introduction and personal questions

missions.title: Healthy Life Mission
missions.focus: health vocabulary, habits, symptoms, advice with should/shouldn't

missions.title: At the Doctor
missions.focus: describing symptoms, answering questions, asking for clarification and following instructions

missions.title: Shopping Problem Solver
missions.focus: sizes, prices, returns, exchanges, preferences and polite complaints

missions.title: A2 Conversation Lab
missions.focus: 6-minute conversation with follow-up questions, reasons, preferences and past experiences

missions.title: Reading Explorer — The Unexpected Day
missions.focus: 450–550 word narrative, main idea, details, sequence and simple inference

missions.title: Listening Explorer — Three Voices
missions.focus: multi-speaker A2 listening with key details, opinions, times and corrections

missions.title: Connectors & Better Sentences
missions.focus: because, so, although, when, before, after, then and finally

missions.title: Write a Real Story
missions.focus: 180–220 word personal story with beginning, events, problem, solution and ending

missions.title: Hotel Mission — Check-In & Problems
missions.focus: booking details, check-in, room requests, facilities and solving a simple hotel issue

missions.title: Airport & Travel Challenge
missions.focus: departure information, baggage, boarding, directions, delays and asking for help

missions.title: Plans, Invitations & Social English
missions.focus: inviting, accepting, refusing politely, arranging times and changing plans

missions.title: Explain It Another Way
missions.focus: paraphrasing, describing unknown words, giving examples and repairing communication breakdowns

missions.title: A2 Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.focus: long-form integrated assessment across vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing

missions.title: WORLD 8 FINAL MASTER QUEST — A2 EVERYDAY ENGLISH
missions.focus: final A2 mission combining natural dialogue, reading, listening, writing, travel/health/shop scenarios and independent speaking

grammar: will for simple decisions and predictions
content_targets.reading: 450–550 word A2 texts with main-idea, detail, sequence and simple-inference tasks
content_targets.listening: 4–6 minute A2 recordings including multi-speaker everyday conversations
content_targets.speaking: 6-minute guided-to-independent conversations with follow-up questions and reasons
content_targets.writing: 180–220 word connected stories, descriptions and practical messages
content_targets.mastery: Learner can handle familiar everyday conversations, describe past events, discuss current and future situations, explain simple problems, ask follow-up questions, understand the main points of ordinary speech and write connected A2-level texts.
